### Executive Summary
A security flaw reported in the Microsoft Authenticator application for Android allows malicious applications to steal user account tokens. 

The vulnerability enables token exfiltration even when the malicious application possesses zero Android permissions, posing a potential compromise risk for accounts relying on the app.

### Technical Impact & Root Cause
The vulnerability impacts token management within Microsoft Authenticator on the Android platform. By exploiting this issue, an unprivileged malicious application executing locally on a target device can extract account tokens without requesting or requiring explicit user permissions.

The underlying technical root cause and the specific range of affected Microsoft Authenticator app versions are not yet confirmed in the provided source material.

### Mitigation & IOCs
Specific vendor mitigations, workarounds, or security updates are not yet confirmed in the provided report. Users and administrators should monitor official Microsoft security advisories for incoming patches addressing Microsoft Authenticator on Android.
